reviews.text: We have been using Larsen Pool services for over 5 years. They provide great service at a fair price. And they have helped keep our pool in excellent shape. I would highly recommend Larsen and his team.
reviews.author: S George

reviews.text: A family company that keeps your pool sparkling clean at a reasonable price. I have weekly service but I've also had them install a new pool/hot tub heater and that was a great experience too and it runs like a champ! They're most reasonable and customer focused pool company I've worked with and I've owned multiple pools and used many pool companies in the Metroplex in last 20 years. I'd give this company a shot for your business of you're looking for a service or repair. They do a great job!
reviews.author: Alan Perdue

reviews.text: We have had a hard time finding a reputable pool service company. But we have been very pleased with Larsen Pools. They show up when they are supposed to and my pool is always clean. I highly recommend them.
reviews.author: shan b

reviews.text: LARSEN pools has serviced our pool since 2007. We have found them courteous and helpful when various needs beyond weekly service Arose with our pool Including scheduling filter, flushes and extra cleanings due to weather event events. We appreciate you LARSEN pools!
reviews.author: Paul Kuehler

reviews.text: I called Larsen Pools on Monday and spoke to the lady who answered the phone. After explaining the problem she said someone would be out the next day(Tuesday)to check out our pool. I stayed at home all day waiting for them to show up, but they never did. I called back Wednesday morning and the lady who answered the phone said they were coming later that day. Once again, I stayed home all day and nobody showed up. It's now Thursday afternoon and I haven't seen or heard from them.  If you value your time at all, I would avoid using this company.
reviews.author: Richard Guditis

reviews.text: Don’t give them your debit or credit card information; as other reviewers have mentioned there will be unauthorized charges and they also charge more than quoted. I tried them for a while and it was not reliable and they lie attempting to get you to have more work done than necessary; I found another business. A previous employee of theirs told me he even had thousands stolen from him out of his paychecks while working there.
reviews.author: My Review

reviews.text: I recommend Larsen Pools to anyone that is asking for a referral.  I have been using them for more than 10 years and find them to be knowledgeable, courteous, professional and extremely hard working.  I have had terrible experiences with 3 other pool companies before trying Larsen Pools.  The first time I needed their help, they walked me through my issue over the phone and didn't charge me anything.  This is the true definition of customer service. They have had my business ever since and I can't imagine using anyone else.
reviews.author: Brenda Larsen

reviews.text: This is a great family-owned business that takes pride in the exceptional service they provide.  Our pool pump had been leaking for months and finally gave out several weeks ago.  We tried for months to have the leak fixed by Personal Touch Pool Care, and once the pump went out, we just couldn’t take it anymore.  We switched to Larsen Pools and literally the next day Leif Larsen (owner) came to our house and personally fixed the leak.  He ordered a new pump that day, and as soon as it arrived he personally came back to our home an installed the pump.  I am still amazed by the service.  We tried for months with our previous company to have an issue never be fixed, that Larsen fixed in days.  Thanks again Larsen Pools!!
reviews.author: Caleb Kokenes

reviews.text:
Been with Larsen’s for years.
They always do a great job.
My pool is older, but Leif always figures it out.
They are the best pool service around!!!
reviews.author: Mary Jo Tallant-Ball

reviews.text: Larsen has serviced my pool for 3 years now. They do a great job keeping me clean & running smoothly.  I highly recommend them!
reviews.author: Jennifer M

reviews.text: Larson Pools is an amazing company.  I have the same pool cleaner every time.  He is very nice and lets me know if I have an issue promptly.  They are very reasonable if you ever have an issue that needs repaired.  I highly recommend them to anyone who needs pool cleaning service or repairs.
reviews.author: Stephanie Gilliam Ritchey

reviews.text:
Larson Pools has done a wonderful job of maintaining our pool. The two men that come weekly don’t leave until
the pool is sparkling and every thing is ready to go. We appreciate their work and pride i n their work.
reviews.author: Melissa Evans

reviews.text:
Been a customer for almost a decade.  This company does a very good job on pool maintenance and repairs. If holidays fall on your cleaning day, they will do it the day after, even if it is a weekend. Workers are courteous and quick.

The ONLY complaint I have is receiving bills. I do not know if their e-mail address is flagged as spam to Yahoo! and Google (Larsen's does NOT spam their customers), but I had some months where I wouldn't get a statement via email.  If you use this company, they keep great records. I never have a problem getting bills if I asked for paper statements instead of e-mail.

There was one month I double paid, and they caught it.  They asked if I wanted credit or reimbursement. The Larsens are very honest and nice.
reviews.author: Fat Tony

reviews.text: I was searching for a local pool company to service/repair my pool.   My pool is in need of repair and I was calling to request an estimate.   As a female, I was excited to read on Larsen Pool website under repair written “Even if you don't know what's wrong, give us a call and we'll be on site to diagnose and conduct repairs. Our passion for pools is equal to love of your pool."  This is a line a copied and pasted direct from their site, so that you could understand my expectations.  When I called, the woman that answered proceeded to tell me that it was the skimmers, I told her that was not the issue.  I informed her that my husband said that the pool is gurgling and that he believes that there is air in the lines.  The female rep with Larsen Pool then asked me if she could speak to my husband instead of me and if she could have his number to call for more information.   I felt that was a very odd way to conduct business.  Do not recommend calling unless you know exactly the repair you need to make.  I cannot speak on their service as I did not get past their screening phase of my pool expertise.
reviews.author: Rebecca Sills

reviews.text: Our family has been beyond happy with Larsen's professional and friendly service for 20+ years. We use them for both personal and business and couldn't be more pleased.
reviews.author: Alicia Neblett

reviews.text: I needed them to come vac my pool to waste.  Sent a tech out.  Seemed like he brought his friend to work with him.  They were there for about 90 minutes and left.  I check my account balance and for starters they charged my account without informing me.  Also they charged me double what I was expecting.  I called in and they said 2 technicians for 90 minutes was what they charged me for.  I paid for a kid to stand around my pool watching his buddy.  They only told me it was $70 an hour, not $70 an hour per person.  The second person was 100% unnecessary.  DO NOT GIVE THEM YOUR PAYMENT INFORMATION AHEAD OF TIME!  BETTER YET DON'T USE THEM
reviews.author: John Brooks

reviews.text:
First time using Larsen Pools for a service call. Scheduled the call and Lief arrived on time. He quickly accessed the issue to be a bad relay on our control board. He had the part with him and was done in 20 minutes.

I found Lief to be professional and I have now found our new Pool Service Company.

Bob Majecki
reviews.author: Robert Majecki

reviews.text: Always great service. Invaluable, helpful, and friendly staff.
reviews.author: Michael Fraga

reviews.text: Do not give this company your credit card information. They are constantly charging unauthorized charges. After several attempts to try to rectify the issue with this company, it continuously happens. Next I am filing a police report. I will never do business with this company again. Be Aware!!!
reviews.author: Kae Flanigan

reviews.text: Not reliable and overcharged received a bill for over $1600 should have been at least half of that for repairs. I continually requested quotes but staff just showed up and did work then charged. Also overcharged for a cleaning and was advised reimbursement check “was in the mail” but was never received.
reviews.author: Veronica Martinez

reviews.text: The couple owning & operating this business are exceptionally dishonest & deceptive. Do not do business here unless getting very dishonest high prices & unnecessary pool work recommendations are ok to you to waste so much more money than you should be paying often for work that was not done or wasn't needed in the first place. They also steal from employees, three of their workers in the past explained to me in detail being stolen from continuously before quitting. People with this disgusting character have no business running a business or representing Christ. I'm disgusted with the larsens
reviews.author: lilly Richface

reviews.text:
I would avoid this company if at all possible. They are disorganized and Lief has a pretty bad attitude. We called for an appointment and they never showed up. When we called back, they scheduled us for the next day (since they’d never put us in the calendar to begin with). They didn’t show up the next day either. But they did tell us we needed an additional part, which they didn’t carry. This was our 4-5th call with them and they decided to mention it then.
On the third day, they promised to show up “first thing.” They fixed the problem and left without explaining anything to us. We needed to let some glue dry, but we had no idea for how long.

Bottom line: everything (even a simple answer) will take at least 3 phone calls. They don’t really seem to care if their customers are happy.
reviews.author: Courtney Pixler

reviews.text: Larsen pools has been great for us.  Good people, honest and dependable. We've used them for 5 years.  No complaints.
reviews.author: Carolyn Morley

reviews.text: I have been doing business with Larsens for over 6 years and I have always found them to be courteous, honest, and fair.  Jobs have been completed on time and at a reasonable cost.
reviews.author: James Vogelgesang

reviews.text: They do a great job on servicing our pool, very happy with Larsen Pools.  Thank you!
reviews.author: Bob Alger

reviews.text: They do great work!
reviews.author: Johnny Hines

reviews.text: Great job.  I called them with an issue about my pool not working and a freeze coming that night and they came out an hour later and fixed it.  Answered all my questions and very friendly.
reviews.author: DJ Russell

reviews.text: They clean our pool weekly and do a very nice job.
reviews.author: b thomas

data.summary: Reviews show authentic customer experiences with clear patterns. Positive reviews emphasize long-term reliability and owner involvement. Negative reviews consistently cite billing issues, no-shows, and communication problems. The business appears to have loyal long-term customers but struggles with administrative consistency and new customer onboarding.

Some 5-star reviews are generic ('great service', 'fair price')
Multiple 1-star reviews from same time period (a year ago) could indicate coordinated negative feedback

Charged for unnecessary work according to reviewers
positive_evidence: Owner personally fixed leak and ordered new pump promptly
Helped over phone without charge for initial issue

authentic_signals: Specific details in positive reviews (Leif Larsen owner name, 10+ year customer relationships, filter flushes, weather events)
Emotional authenticity in negative reviews (specific dates, amounts $1600, waiting home all day)
Varied writing styles and perspectives across reviews
